title: The Summary export has no Sales Type column and rep rows leave it blank
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A and sales rep B, so that the work order can have a different Labor and Parts representative.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Have a work order for that customer with a labor line and a part, Labor set to sales rep A and Parts set to sales rep B, and invoice it today, so the Expanded CSV has a representative row for sales rep A and separate Labor and Parts rows.
  • Open Reports > Sales By Representative in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide, with the date range set to today.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Export the Summary CSV and look at its columns.
  2. Export the Expanded CSV and read the Sales Type cell on sales rep A's representative row and on the totals row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Summary export has no Sales Type column.

Step 2:

  • The Sales Type cell is blank on the representative row and on the totals row.
  • Only invoice rows carry Labor, Parts, Part Sales or "Labor, Parts".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • S5-R23: “The Expanded CSV and the Expanded PDF always carry the Sales Type column, after Status and before Location, whatever the screen shows. In them, the cells of the side a row is not credited with are blank in the CSV and show a dash in the PDF.”

From: Tech plan "Splitting Sales Representatives — Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 14 Oct 2026, planned against PRD version 8; uploaded 19 Oct 2026 and again, byte-identical, 22 Oct 2026), read in full 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan, export column: “in `expanded()` only, never in `summary()`.”
  • Tech plan, Expanded export values: “"Labor" / "Parts" / "Part Sales" / "Labor, Parts" (blank on rep and total rows).”
